info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Status Retrieval API provides users with the ability to query the current statuses of various mortgage loans. This endpoint facilitates tracking and managing the lifecycle of mortgage applications, enabling financial institutions and borrowers to stay informed. The primary resource is the loan status data, which can be accessed for individual or bulk requests. Typical consumers include mortgage lenders, processors, and borrowers who require up-to-date information on loan applications and approvals.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of loans.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all loans in the system. You can use this information to check whether loans are active, paid off, or in default.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of loans. This request expects a JSON payload that adheres to the defined schema, which encapsulates the necessary parameters to perform the operation effectively.

ListMortgageLoansStatusRequest.description: A string representing the status of the loan operation.

ListMortgageLoansStatusResponse_200.title: Loan Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the loan status retrieval operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the loan.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the loan status check.

state.description: The current state of the loan.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the loan status request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information regarding the loan status.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the loan status request.

ListMortgageLoansStatusResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful loan status retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was performed automatically or manually.

AuditInfo.description: This schema represents the audit information related to the loan status request.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
